native_state_policy.eligibility: Actual selected first-party processor, valid native LayerProcessorState and supported recipe; MissingState/InvalidState grant no authored pose authority
native_state_policy.construction: Each actual owned tile GetIndustryConstructionStage selects0..3; already complete cells stay3 while IsLayerIndustryComplete waits for the whole industry
native_state_policy.ready: GetLayerProcessorOperationalStatus::Idle: actual required input cannot supply a complete batch, independently of banked work; final output remains physical
native_state_policy.working: GetLayerProcessorOperationalStatus::Working: shared CaptureLayerProcessorInventory/common PlanMultiLayerRecipeBatches admit one batch's actual all-input/output prerequisites; presentation earns no work
native_state_policy.blocked: Actual OutputFull/Paused/Stopped/Unavailable; Industry input/output and existing recipe/work/history remain unchanged
native_state_policy.quantity_owner: Existing Industry accepted/produced slots and common native atomic recipe commit; no source-state cargo inventory
native_state_policy.frame_owner: construction actual GetIndustryConstructionStage; working existing synchronized TimerGameTick::counter presentation only; ready/blocked static phase0 aliases
